title: MdmDeviceDetail.Attributes
description:
The attributes for a device management service enrolled device detail resource.

Introduced in Apple Business API 2.6.

bluetoothMacAddress.description: The Bluetooth MAC address of the device.

deviceEraseStatus.description: The erase status of the device.

deviceLockStatus.description: The lock status of the device.

ethernetMacAddress.description: The Ethernet MAC address of the device.

imei.description: The IMEI numbers of the device.

isFileVaultEnabled.description: A Boolean value indicating whether FileVault is enabled on the device.

isFirewallEnabled.description: A Boolean value indicating whether the firewall is enabled on the device.

lastCheckInDateTime.description: The date and time the device last checked in.

lostModeStatus.description: The lost mode status of the device.

meid.description: The Mobile Equipment Identifier numbers of the device.

osVersion.description: The operating system version of the device.

serialNumber.description: The serial number of the device.

storageFreeCapacity.description: The free storage capacity of the device, in bytes.

storageTotalCapacity.description: The total storage capacity of the device, in bytes.

wifiMacAddress.description: The Wi-Fi MAC address of the device.
